verdict.rationale: The pack includes a first-party public GitHub repository (github.com/superset-sh/superset), and a community commenter praises the project architecture, which suggests the source can be read. Nothing in the evidence states which license the code uses, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g. an OSS license file or docs statement), confirmation that the full app source rather than just a README is public, and independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
